evidence.title: Why is my Computer Slow? TMOG Knows Why!

name: TMOG
summary: Native task manager for macOS, Windows and Linux that names the process and subsystem behind a slow computer.
description: One shared C++20 measuring core with native applications on each platform: a sortable process hierarchy with CPU, memory, disk, network and energy impact, and a Flight Recorder that replays the last slow hour. The free edition is a full system monitor; advanced capabilities sit in a paid PRO edition.
contains: task manager for macOS, Windows and Linux
12 destinations incl. Summary, Performance, Processes, Power & Freq, Connections and Benchmarks
live process hierarchy sortable and filterable by CPU, memory, disk, network and energy impact
Flight Recorder records and replays telemetry as .tmogtrace (PRO)
Swift/AppKit, C++/Win32 and C++/Qt 6 over one shared measuring core
free edition; PRO sold through Lemon Squeezy
no usage statistics or identifiers sent; only an update check
